amazon.item_name: Kesari Alphonso Mango Pulp from Ratnagiri, No Added Sugar, 850 g
amazon.highlights: Natural Sweetness, For Aamras, Milkshakes and Desserts
bullets: RATNAGIRI ALPHONSO: Made only from Alphonso (Hapus) mangoes grown in Ratnagiri, for the deep colour and aroma the variety is known for
NO ADDED SUGAR OR PRESERVATIVES: Sweetness comes from the fruit itself, about 17 degrees Brix, with no added sugar and no added preservatives
READY TO USE: Pour straight into aamras, lassi, milkshakes, ice cream and desserts; an 850 g can makes about 3.5 cups
STORE WELL: Keeps for 18 months unopened; refrigerate after opening and use within 3 days
FROM A FAMILY BUSINESS: Packed by Kesari Foods in Ratnagiri, who also deliver fresh Alphonso boxes in season
amazon.description:
Kesari Alphonso mango pulp is made from Alphonso mangoes grown in Ratnagiri and nothing else.

Use it for aamras with puris, mango lassi, milkshakes and desserts all year round. Refrigerate after opening and use within 3 days.
